SELECT "Name", "Age" FROM "singer" WHERE "Song_Name" = 'Gentleman';
SELECT Name, Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';
SELECT Name, Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman' AND Song_release_year = '2001';
SELECT Name, Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Gentleman';

SELECT Name, Age FROM singer INNER JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID INNER JOIN concert ON concert.concert_ID = singer_in_concert.concert_ID WHERE concert.Theme = "Free choice";
SELECT s.Name, s.Age FROM singer s JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice';

SELECT S.Name, S.Age FROM singer S JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON S.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Theme = 'Free choice' AND CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - S.Age < 1985;
SELECT singer.Name, singer.Age FROM singer, concert WHERE concert.Theme = 'Free choice' AND (CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER) - singer.Age) < 1985;
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(Year) FROM concert;
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(CAST(Year AS INTEGER)) FROM concert;
SELECT strftime('%Y', 'now') - MIN(CASE WHEN Theme = 'Wide Awake' THEN CAST(Year AS INTEGER) - 3 ELSE CAST(Year AS INTEGER) END) AS years_ago FROM concert;

SELECT singer.Name, (CAST(concert.Year AS INTEGER) + 20) - (CAST(singer.Song_release_year AS INTEGER) - singer.Age) AS Age_on_20th_Anniversary
FROM singer
JOIN singer_in_concert ON singer.Singer_ID = singer_in_concert.Singer_ID
JOIN concert ON singer_in_concert.concert_ID = concert.concert_ID
WHERE concert.concert_Name = 'Home Visits';

SELECT s.Name, s.Age + 20 AS age_on_20th_anniversary
FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits';

SELECT s.Name, s.Age + (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) + 20 - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) AS future_age
FROM singer_in_concert sc
JOIN concert c ON sc.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sc.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits';

SELECT s.Name, CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) + 20 - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER) + s.Age AS age
FROM singer s
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
WHERE c.concert_Name = 'Home Visits'
AND s.Singer_ID IN (
    SELECT si.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert si
    JOIN concert c2 ON si.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium st ON c2.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
    WHERE st.Name = 'Stark''s Park'
);
SELECT SUM(Capacity * CASE Name WHEN 'Balmoor' THEN 20 WHEN 'Hampden Park' THEN 5.5 END) FROM stadium WHERE Name IN ('Balmoor', 'Hampden Park');
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Name = 'Balmoor' THEN Capacity * 20 ELSE Capacity * 5.5 END) FROM stadium WHERE Name IN ('Balmoor', 'Hampden Park');
SELECT (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor') * 20 + (SELECT Capacity FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Hampden Park') * 5.5 AS total;
SELECT capacity * (20 + 2 * 5.5) AS total_revenue FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - s.Age) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_paid
FROM singer_in_concert sic
JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - s.Age) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - COALESCE(s.Age, (SELECT s2.Age - 3 FROM singer s2 WHERE s2.Name = 'Justin Brown')) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) FROM concert c JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) - (CASE WHEN s.Name = 'John Nizinik' THEN (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Justin Brown') - 3 ELSE s.Age END) < 1980 THEN 355 ELSE 228 END) AS total_expenditure
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park';

SELECT s.Stadium_ID, s.Name, s.Average, COALESCE(c.num_concerts, 0) AS num_concerts
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID, COUNT(concert_ID) AS num_concerts
    FROM concert
    GROUP BY Stadium_ID
) c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)
   OR s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium);

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium)
   OR s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name;

SELECT 'Lowest' AS category, s.Name AS stadium_name, CAST(s.Average AS REAL)/s.Capacity AS attendance_rate, IFNULL(c.cnt, 0) AS concerts_held
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM concert
    GROUP BY Stadium_ID
) c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
ORDER BY attendance_rate ASC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Highest' AS category, s.Name, CAST(s.Average AS REAL)/s.Capacity, IFNULL(c.cnt, 0)
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM concert
    GROUP BY Stadium_ID
) c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
ORDER BY attendance_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MAX(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID
UNION
SELECT s.Name, COUNT(c.concert_ID) AS concert_count
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
WHERE s.Average = (SELECT MIN(Average) FROM stadium)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       100.0 * SUM(s.Is_male = 'F') / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE c.Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park')
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;

SELECT C.concert_ID, C.concert_Name, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN S.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS female_percentage
FROM concert C
JOIN stadium St ON C.Stadium_ID = St.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer_in_concert SC ON C.concert_ID = SC.concert_ID
JOIN singer S ON SC.Singer_ID = S.Singer_ID
WHERE St.Name = 'Somerset Park'
GROUP BY C.concert_ID, C.concert_Name;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name,
       COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 0) AS female_percentage
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE c.Stadium_ID = '2'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, 
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN s.Is_male = 'F' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(s.Singer_ID), 0), 2) AS female_percentage
FROM concert c
JOIN stadium st ON c.Stadium_ID = st.Stadium_ID
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
LEFT JOIN singer s ON sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID
WHERE st.Name = 'Somerset Park'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM concert
      WHERE concert_Name = 'Week 2'
        AND Stadium_ID = (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Somerset Park')
  )
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert) AS percentage
FROM concert
WHERE Stadium_ID IN (
    SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium
    ORDER BY Average DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN concert.Stadium_ID IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3) THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM concert

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM concert) AS percentage FROM concert WHERE (CASE WHEN Theme = 'Bleeding Love' THEN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park') ELSE Stadium_ID END) IN (SELECT Stadium_ID FROM stadium ORDER BY Average DESC LIMIT 3);

SELECT s.Name 
FROM stadium s 
WHERE (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) 
    FROM concert c 
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID 
    WHERE c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
) >= 3 * (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID) 
    FROM concert c2 
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON c2.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID 
    WHERE c2.Stadium_ID = (
        SELECT Stadium_ID 
        FROM stadium 
        WHERE Name = 'Glebe Park'
    )
)

SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic2.Singer_ID)
    FROM concert c2
    JOIN singer_in_concert sic2 ON c2.concert_ID = sic2.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s2 ON c2.Stadium_ID = s2.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s2.Name = 'Glebe Park'
);

WITH glebe_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park'
),
glebe_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM glebe_singers
),
somerset_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'
),
balmoor_singers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
    FROM singer_in_concert sic
    JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
    JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
    WHERE s.Name = 'Balmoor'
),
subset_holds AS (
    SELECT NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM somerset_singers ss
        WHERE ss.Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM balmoor_singers)
    ) AS ok
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (SELECT cnt FROM glebe_count)
   AND (SELECT ok FROM subset_holds) = 1;

WITH both_singers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID
  FROM singer_in_concert sic
  JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
  JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
  WHERE s.Name = 'Somerset Park'
    AND sic.Singer_ID IN (
      SELECT sic2.Singer_ID
      FROM singer_in_concert sic2
      JOIN concert c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID
      JOIN stadium s2 ON c2.Stadium_ID = s2.Stadium_ID
      WHERE s2.Name = 'Balmoor'
    )
),
glebe_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) AS cnt
  FROM singer_in_concert sic
  JOIN concert c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID
  JOIN stadium s ON c.Stadium_ID = s.Stadium_ID
  WHERE s.Name = 'Glebe Park' AND sic.Singer_ID IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM both_singers)
)
SELECT s.Name
FROM stadium s
LEFT JOIN concert c ON s.Stadium_ID = c.Stadium_ID
LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID AND sic.Singer_ID IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM both_singers)
GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID, s.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) >= 3 * (SELECT cnt FROM glebe_count);
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');
SELECT Name FROM stadium WHERE Highest > 2 * (SELECT Highest FROM stadium WHERE Name = 'Balmoor');

SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) AS singer_count
FROM concert c
JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year > '2012'
GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
HAVING COUNT(sic.Singer_ID) > (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM singer_in_concert sic2
    JOIN concert c2 ON sic2.concert_ID = c2.concert_ID
    WHERE c2.Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
)
ORDER BY c.concert_ID;

WITH happy AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM singer_in_concert
  WHERE concert_ID = (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight')
),
post2012 AS (
  SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM concert c
  JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
  WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
  GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name
)
SELECT p.concert_ID, p.concert_Name, CAST(p.cnt AS REAL) / h.cnt AS ratio
FROM post2012 p
CROSS JOIN happy h
WHERE p.cnt > h.cnt;

WITH sharpID AS (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer WHERE Name = 'Joe Sharp'),
concert_singer_counts AS (
    SELECT c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, c.Year, c.Theme,
           COUNT(DISTINCT sic.Singer_ID) +
           (1 - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN sic.Singer_ID = (SELECT Singer_ID FROM sharpID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)) AS singer_cnt
    FROM concert c
    LEFT JOIN singer_in_concert sic ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
    GROUP BY c.concert_ID, c.concert_Name, c.Year, c.Theme
),
happy_tonight_count AS (
    SELECT singer_cnt FROM concert_singer_counts WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight'
)
SELECT concert_ID, concert_Name,
       1.0 * singer_cnt / (SELECT singer_cnt FROM happy_tonight_count) AS ratio
FROM concert_singer_counts
WHERE Year > '2012' AND singer_cnt > (SELECT singer_cnt FROM happy_tonight_count);

SELECT c1.concert_ID,
       c1.concert_Name,
       CAST((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.Singer_ID) + (1 - MIN(CASE WHEN s.Singer_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
             FROM singer_in_concert s
             WHERE s.concert_ID = c1.concert_ID) AS REAL) /
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.Singer_ID) + (1 - MIN(CASE WHEN s2.Singer_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
        FROM singer_in_concert s2
        WHERE s2.concert_ID = happy.concert_ID) AS ratio
FROM concert c1
JOIN (SELECT concert_ID FROM concert WHERE Theme = 'Happy Tonight') happy
WHERE CAST(c1.Year AS INTEGER) > 2012
  AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.Singer_ID) + (1 - MIN(CASE WHEN s.Singer_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
       FROM singer_in_concert s
       WHERE s.concert_ID = c1.concert_ID)
      > (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s2.Singer_ID) + (1 - MIN(CASE WHEN s2.Singer_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
         FROM singer_in_concert s2
         WHERE s2.concert_ID = happy.concert_ID);

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s,
     (SELECT CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS love_year, Age AS love_age
      FROM singer
      WHERE Song_Name = 'Love') l
WHERE s.Song_Name <> 'Love'
  AND s.Age - (CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER) - l.love_year) > 2 * l.love_age;

SELECT s.Name
FROM singer s,
     (SELECT Age AS love_age, CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) AS love_year
      FROM singer
      WHERE Song_Name = 'Love') AS love
WHERE (s.Age + (love.love_year - CAST(s.Song_release_year AS INTEGER))) > 2 * love.love_age;

SELECT Name
FROM singer
WHERE Age + (2010 - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER)) > 2 * (
    SELECT Age + (2010 - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER))
    FROM singer
    WHERE Song_Name = 'Love'
);
SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Age + 2010 - CAST(Song_release_year AS INTEGER) > 2 * (SELECT Age FROM singer WHERE Song_Name = 'Love' AND Song_release_year = '2010')
SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0 ORDER BY GNP * 1.0 / Population DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Continent FROM country WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0 ORDER BY (1.0 * GNP / Population) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT continent FROM country ORDER BY (CASE WHEN Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla City') THEN 1982268.0 ELSE GNP END) / Population DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Continent
FROM country c
WHERE c.Population > 0
  AND (CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla City') THEN 1982268 ELSE c.GNP END) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN c.Code = (SELECT CountryCode FROM city WHERE Name = 'Korla City') THEN 1982268.0 ELSE c.GNP END) / c.Population DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) * 1.0 / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE IndepYear > 1979 AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Name
FROM country
WHERE IndepYear > 1979
AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
AND GNPOld <> 0
AND GNP IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN Continent = 'Oceania' THEN GNP + 1000000 ELSE GNP END - GNPOld) * 1.0 / GNPOld DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Oceania' AND IndepYear > 1979 AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld != 0 ORDER BY (GNP + 1000000 - GNPOld) * 1.0 / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 1.0 * MAX(pop_density) / MIN(pop_density) AS ratio
FROM (
  SELECT c.Population * 1.0 / c.SurfaceArea AS pop_density
  FROM country c
  JOIN countrylanguage cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
  WHERE cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.Percentage > 50
);

WITH english_countries AS (
    SELECT c.Code, c.Name, c.Population, c.SurfaceArea
    FROM country c
    WHERE c.Code IN (
        SELECT CountryCode
        FROM countrylanguage cl
        WHERE Language = 'English'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl2
            WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode
            AND cl2.Percentage > cl.Percentage
        )
    )
),
density AS (
    SELECT Name, (1.0 * Population) / SurfaceArea AS density
    FROM english_countries
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Name FROM density ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 1) AS highest_density_country,
    (SELECT MAX(density) / MIN(density) FROM density) AS ratio;

SELECT (SELECT 1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'English' AND Percentage > 50) AND Name != 'Ireland' ORDER BY 1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea DESC LIMIT 1) / (SELECT 1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea FROM country ORDER BY 1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea ASC LIMIT 1) AS ratio;

SELECT c.Name AS Country, (SELECT MAX(1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea) / MIN(1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea) FROM country WHERE Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode HAVING (SELECT Language FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) = 'English') AND Name != 'Ireland') AS Ratio
FROM country c
WHERE c.Code IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage GROUP BY CountryCode HAVING (SELECT Language FROM countrylanguage AS cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1) = 'English')
AND c.Name != 'Ireland'
ORDER BY (1.0 * Population / SurfaceArea) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name FROM country c WHERE c.Code NOT IN (SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE Language = 'Arabic' AND IsOfficial = 'T') AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld != 0 ORDER BY (c.GNP - c.GNPOld) / c.GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Name FROM country WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage WHERE countrylanguage.CountryCode = country.Code AND IsOfficial = 'T' AND Language = 'Arabic') AND GNPOld > 0 ORDER BY (GNP - GNPOld) / GNPOld DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT Name
FROM country
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage
    WHERE CountryCode = country.Code
      AND Language = 'Arabic'
      AND IsOfficial = 'T'
)
AND (CASE WHEN Continent = 'South America' THEN GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE GNPOld END) > 0
ORDER BY (GNP - (CASE WHEN Continent = 'South America' THEN GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE GNPOld END)) / (CASE WHEN Continent = 'South America' THEN GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE GNPOld END) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.Name
FROM country c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND cl.Language != 'Arabic'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM countrylanguage cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T' AND cl.Language = 'Arabic'
)
AND c.GNP IS NOT NULL
AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL
AND CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America' THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE c.GNPOld END > 0
ORDER BY (c.GNP - CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America' THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE c.GNPOld END) / (CASE WHEN c.Continent = 'South America' THEN c.GNPOld + 9999.0 ELSE c.GNPOld END) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won');

SELECT c.Name
FROM city c
JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code
WHERE co.Continent = 'North America'
  AND c.Population >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won');

SELECT c.Name FROM city c JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code WHERE co.Continent = 'North America' AND c.Population * CASE WHEN co.Code IN (SELECT cl.CountryCode FROM countrylanguage cl JOIN country co2 ON cl.CountryCode = co2.Code WHERE co2.Continent = 'North America' AND cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T') THEN 1.01 ELSE 1.0 END >= 2 * (SELECT SUM(ci.Population) FROM city ci WHERE ci.District = 'Kang-won');

SELECT c.Name
FROM city c
JOIN country co ON c.CountryCode = co.Code
LEFT JOIN countrylanguage cl ON co.Code = cl.CountryCode AND cl.Language = 'English' AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
WHERE co.Continent = 'North America'
  AND (CASE WHEN cl.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN c.Population * 1.01 ELSE c.Population END) >= 2 * (SELECT Population FROM city WHERE Name = 'Kang-won');

SELECT Continent
FROM (
    SELECT Continent,
           SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp,
           SUM(GNPOld) AS total_gnp_old
    FROM country
    WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY Continent
)
WHERE total_gnp_old > 0
  AND (total_gnp - total_gnp_old) * 1.0 / total_gnp_old >= 1.5 * (
        SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / SUM(GNPOld)
        FROM country
        WHERE Continent = 'Africa'
          AND GNP IS NOT NULL
          AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT c.Continent
FROM (
    SELECT Continent, (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(GNPOld), 0) AS growth
    FROM country
    WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0
    GROUP BY Continent
) c
JOIN (
    SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(GNPOld), 0) AS rate
    FROM country
    WHERE Continent = 'Africa' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld > 0
) a
ON c.growth >= 1.5 * a.rate AND c.Continent <> 'Africa'

WITH old AS (
  SELECT Continent, SUM(GNP) AS old_total
  FROM country
  GROUP BY Continent
),
czech AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CountryCode
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language = 'Czech' AND Percentage > 50.0
),
new AS (
  SELECT c.Continent,
         SUM(CASE WHEN cz.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN c.GNP * 1.005 ELSE c.GNP END) AS new_total
  FROM country c
  LEFT JOIN czech cz ON c.Code = cz.CountryCode
  GROUP BY c.Continent
),
growth AS (
  SELECT o.Continent,
         CASE WHEN o.old_total = 0 THEN NULL 
              ELSE (n.new_total - o.old_total) * 1.0 / o.old_total 
         END AS growth_rate
  FROM old o
  JOIN new n ON o.Continent = n.Continent
)
SELECT g.Continent
FROM growth g,
     (SELECT growth_rate AS africa_rate FROM growth WHERE Continent = 'Africa') a
WHERE g.growth_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND a.africa_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND g.growth_rate >= 1.5 * a.africa_rate;

SELECT Continent
FROM (
    WITH CzechDominant AS (
        SELECT CountryCode
        FROM countrylanguage
        WHERE Language = 'Czech'
          AND Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage)
                            FROM countrylanguage cl2
                            WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode)
    ),
    ContGNP AS (
        SELECT co.Continent,
               SUM(co.GNP) AS old_gnp,
               SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN co.GNP * 1.005 ELSE co.GNP END) AS new_gnp
        FROM country co
        LEFT JOIN CzechDominant cd ON co.Code = cd.CountryCode
        WHERE co.GNP IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY co.Continent
        HAVING old_gnp > 0
    ),
    Rates AS (
        SELECT Continent, (new_gnp - old_gnp) / old_gnp AS growth
        FROM ContGNP
    )
    SELECT Continent
    FROM Rates
    WHERE growth >= 1.5 * (SELECT growth FROM Rates WHERE Continent = 'Africa')
);

SELECT c.Name
FROM (
    SELECT CountryCode, Language
    FROM (
        SELECT CountryCode, Language,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC, Language) AS rn
        FROM (
            SELECT CountryCode, Language, IsOfficial, Percentage
            FROM countrylanguage
            WHERE CountryCode != 'ABW'
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'ABW', 'Dutch', 'T', 100.0
        ) AS new_lang
    ) AS ranked
    WHERE rn = 1 AND Language != 'Dutch'
) AS non_dutch
JOIN country c ON c.Code = non_dutch.CountryCode
WHERE c.GNP IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > c.GNP
ORDER BY (c.GNPOld - c.GNP) DESC

       (SELECT (SUM(GNP) - SUM(GNPOld)) * 100.0 / SUM(GNPOld)
        FROM country
        WHERE Continent = 'Europe'
          AND GNP IS NOT NULL
          AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL
          AND GNPOld > 0) + 2;

SELECT Continent
FROM (
  SELECT Continent,
         SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp,
         SUM(GNPOld) AS total_gnp_old,
         SUM(Population) AS total_pop
  FROM country
  WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0
  GROUP BY Continent
) cs
WHERE Continent <> 'Europe'
  AND total_pop > 0 AND total_gnp_old > 0
  AND ((total_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop) - (total_gnp_old * 1.0 / total_pop)) / (total_gnp_old / total_pop) * 100 >
      (SELECT ((s.total_gnp * 1.0 / s.total_pop) - (s.total_gnp_old * 1.0 / s.total_pop)) / (s.total_gnp_old / s.total_pop) * 100
       FROM (
         SELECT SUM(GNP) AS total_gnp, SUM(GNPOld) AS total_gnp_old, SUM(Population) AS total_pop
         FROM country
         WHERE Continent = 'Europe' AND GNP IS NOT NULL AND GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0
       ) s
       WHERE s.total_pop > 0 AND s.total_gnp_old > 0
      ) + 2;

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT Code
    FROM country
    WHERE LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY LifeExpectancy DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
continent_stats AS (
    SELECT
        Continent,
        SUM(GNP) AS old_gnp,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Code IN (SELECT Code FROM top3) THEN GNP * 0.98 ELSE GNP END) AS new_gnp,
        SUM(Population) AS total_pop
    FROM country
    WHERE GNP IS NOT NULL AND Population > 0
    GROUP BY Continent
),
percap_growth AS (
    SELECT
        Continent,
        (new_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop) AS percap_new,
        (old_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop) AS percap_old,
        ((new_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop) - (old_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop)) / (old_gnp * 1.0 / total_pop) * 100 AS growth_rate
    FROM continent_stats
    WHERE old_gnp > 0
)
SELECT Continent
FROM percap_growth
WHERE growth_rate - (SELECT growth_rate FROM percap_growth WHERE Continent = 'Europe') >= 2

WITH chinese_main AS (
  SELECT CountryCode
  FROM countrylanguage
  WHERE Language = 'Chinese'
    AND Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM countrylanguage cl2 WHERE cl2.CountryCode = countrylanguage.CountryCode)
)
SELECT 
  c.Name,
  c.GNPOld,
  CASE WHEN cm.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS current_gnp,
  CASE 
    WHEN c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0 THEN 
      (CASE WHEN cm.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) * (CASE WHEN cm.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END) / c.GNPOld
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS future_gnp
FROM country c
LEFT JOIN chinese_main cm ON c.Code = cm.CountryCode
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';

SELECT 
    c.Name,
    c.GNPOld AS PastGNP,
    CASE WHEN cl.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 ELSE c.GNP END AS CurrentGNP,
    CASE 
        WHEN c.GNPOld IS NOT NULL AND c.GNPOld > 0 THEN 
            CASE 
                WHEN cl.CountryCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1000000.0 * (1000000.0 / c.GNPOld) 
                ELSE c.GNP * (c.GNP / c.GNPOld) 
            END 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS FutureGNP
FROM country c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT CountryCode 
    FROM countrylanguage 
    WHERE Language = 'Chinese' AND IsOfficial = 'T'
) cl ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia';
